reviews.text: Very kind

Honestly, I wish every pet and pet parent could experience vet care like this place. Every single person at veterinary care group is attentive to detail, compassionate and good at what they do.

Special shoutout to Stacey the vet tech — you’re the only person who has been able to handle Xander without muzzling him. I’ve clearly found our new home vet!
Great techs and friendly staff, always. Good experience

I went in for a visit for an abnormal spot on my dog’s skin/fur where the vet conducted a check and sent a sample for a lab diagnostic. While at the location I would like to express my gratitude to the staff for being patient, empathetic, and overall really kind to my furry one. For any future vet related incidents I will definitely choose to come here.

I appreciate everyone at the clinic. I’ve been bringing my dog here for his annual visits for the past four years, and every experience has been wonderful.
He can be a little nervous and shy when he first arrives. Everyone here is always so gentle, patient, understanding, and caring with him. Once he gets comfortable, they’re able to see a little more of his personality. I genuinely love bringing him here and have always felt that he’s in good hands. Everyone I’ve worked with has been so kind and I’m very grateful for the care they provide. If anyone ever asked me to recommend a veterinary clinic, this would absolutely be the one I recommend.
We are grateful for your positive feedback! Thank you for your review!
Top notch healthcare for my cat! My cat was handled very well and seemed to enjoy the checkup. Professional, knowledgeable, friendly and fast. I will never consider going anywhere else.

We love the Veterinary Care Group at Whitestone. We’ve been going there for 15 years since my dog Darius was a pup. Then we have Myles too, a very handsome sweet tuxedo kitty who purrs during his visits…my boys love the team in Whitestone. We started out with Dr. Merker way back, then Dr. Rojas , we’ve seen Dr. Pozo and most recently Dr. Abramov…they are all truly warm and kind humans, they care about their patients and families. 🐶 🐱 🥰
All of the staff there are truly and sincerely nice people , they love my fur babies and take very good care of them. I’m so thankful for them 🙏🏻❣️
Incredible kind and helpful people

The staff here are quite friendly and clearly care about the animals, as does the doctor, who is very professional and always asks about the animals' history before proceeding with the appropriate treatment. Although the prices are a bit high, the excellent care makes it worth it.
We are overjoyed to receive your 5-star rating. Your trust in our care means a great deal to our team.
Thank you for the 5-star rating. Your trust in our care means a great deal to us.
Very competent, friendly staff and quality health care attention
Thank you for your positive feedback! We appreciate your support.
Wonderful office!   Dr Rojas is always amazing
Dr Rojas and Joe are simply fantastic as well as the entire staff. My dog actually, it looks forward to going to the doctor there that’s how well he’s treated!!
Amazing staff. Kind souls and patience individuals. We just moved here and I’m so glad to have these professionals around the corner!
Always a great experience.  The staff is so kind and welcoming, they make everyone feel like family. Highly recommend to anyone searching for a Veterinarian.

Dr. Rojas, Stacey, Alisha, Joe are only some of the amazing human angels that made the terrifying experience of my baby girl having a small tumor into a tolerable not so scary experience. They were all so reassuring, patient and loving with my dog and I. My family really appreciates the constant updates throughout the surgery, the love you gave our dog as if she was your own, how gentle, understanding and informative you all are. From pre-op to post-op you guys made us feel like everything was going to be okay.

Nia (my fur child) is healing well and we are so Grateful! Thank you so much Veterinary care group- Whitestone!!! We love you!!
Great job with my big dogs.

Absolutely 100% recommendable. The entire staff was very considerate of Penelope (the feline patient), treating her with great love and care, and also very considerate of the patient's human parents. The doctor explained very clearly how to help our pet, and the nurses were very kind and gentle.
Best place and people ever!!😊 …
Dr. Laura Abramov is an excellent veterinarian. Her love of animals comes through in her care! I have never met someone with such passion for caring for these wonderful creatures!
Excellent care from the whole staff!
Excellent experience.

Wonderful experience as always , staff super friendly and welcoming ,
Loving environment for the pets and the owners!
Staff is professional and caring.

Highly highly recommend this veterinary facility!!! Dr. Pozo and her team are just amazing and wonderful human beings who really care for our pets and just make you feel so comforted and provide you a sense of reassurance when it comes to our pets! They take their time to ask you questions about your pet and any issues. They really demonstrate a genuine and sincere care for our beloved animals ♥️ I am very grateful for Dr. Pozo, and ALL of the vet techs, Joe, Laura and Stacey, whom are absolutely wonderful and delightful, and always take care of my girls! I trust them blindly!!!

The staff was not respectful of cats. They mocked my concern about my cat who was diagnosed diabetic. Dr Rojas prescribed my cat the kind of insulin that every vet I’ve spoken to since says stopped being the standard of care long ago because it is less effective. He recommended dry food, which is not recommended overall and for diabetic cats in particular. He also forgot why he did invasive testing on my cat and I had to remind him to look at particular results on the exam and in the lab work.
If you have a cat, you should take them to a different vet. I cannot speak to the level of care for any other animal.
We are absolutely thrilled to receive your five-star rating and appreciate your trust in our veterinary services.
Needed something done and they fit me right in

Everyone at Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone is incredibly knowledgeable, professional, and kind. It is easy to park around there and I have been seen at my appointment time. There may be emergencies but they do not intentionally overbook their time so you never feel rushed and you are not waiting hours to see them. Stacey is an amazing vet tech and cares so much for my Xena! Highly recommend!!!

The best!! The staff is very compassionate, caring and saved my cats life!! I'm am eternally grateful!!
Stacy and Laura are incredibly dedicated! Thank you!
Thank you for your positive feedback about Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone. We are happy you had a good experience.

This was my first time at Veterinary Care Group, the staff were awesome to deal with, very professional and caring for my baby Shenzi. Dr. Laura Abramov was a pleasure to deal with as well. I definitely recommend this Veterinarian and her staff as well!
Quickly, caring, friendly and extremely supportive and knowledgeable I will never go anywhere else
The staffs are friendly. The place is very clean, no animal smell. My Vet Dr. Pozo was very thorough, patient and gentle to my cat. She's very nice. I like her to be my forever Vet for my cat
They’ve been taking care of my pets for more than 20 years. Love them. The techs are fantastic!
The best no complaints The entire group, a very nice people doctors nurse from offices everybody
We deeply cherish your five-star rating and appreciate you choosing Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone for your pet's care.
nice people
friendly staff that squeezed me in when a concern of mine

First time puppy owner, first vet visit over the weekend, and I couldn’t be happier with how everything went with my baby, Peppino…from the moment we walked through the door to when we left.

The front desk team was so welcoming and efficient, making the check-in process seamless and stress-free.

The veterinary technicians were beyond amazing! They handled Peppino with such care and gentleness, taking time to explain everything they were doing while giving me helpful tips for being a first-time puppy owner. I could tell they genuinely love animals and their job, which made me feel so reassured.

And the vet, Dr. Merker, took the time to do a thorough check-up, answer all my questions (and I had a lot), and give me valuable advice on nutrition, training, and vaccinations.

Overall, I’m so grateful to have found a place where Peppino and I are treated with such kindness and professionalism. Thank you for making this first visit such a great experience!
Great quality of care and staff are terrific
The whole staff was very caring and compassionate. I felt my cat Milo received excellent care there. By the next day he was back to his old self which made me very happy thank you

My cat was sick, so I looked for the nearest vet clinic. I called, and they immediately told me I could bring him in. When I arrived, they were so kind and caring with my baby. They gave me the medicine, and I've seen improvements in just a few days. I'm so grateful to this place; I truly feel they saved my cat's life and mine too. 💗 …

I have been coming here for over 20+ years. I can't say what a pleasure it is to have known the staff for that long and to not dread coming for a vet visit with all the horror stories you hear.
Dr. Rojas, Stacy, Laura and Diane are all so great and you can tell the staff care about all the animals they see.
They're very accommodating as I have called for appointments on the day of with strays I picked up. They also helped my family and I navigate through the loss of some pets and making sure their quality of life was the priority during their last days.
Highly recommend to anyone searching for a vet clinic.

Doctor Oswaldo Rojas and his staff are amazing people. They treat my dog like a human person. They even call me to hear on how she doing with her recovery. I have gone to other veterinarians, and they never bother asking about  my dog's health. I'm the one that have to call for lab results. They just gained a new costumer for life.

Dr. Rojas and Stacy provide high quality care to my family's pets. I appreciate the team's high emotional intelligence, including Diane's, as my pets are treated exceptionally well, and my many questions are directly answered.
Very friendly staff that’s dedicated to providing the best care for your pet. Extremely accommodating , thoughtful and great wait time
We are pleased to hear about your positive experience at Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone. Thank you for sharing your feedback.

Follow up yearly Wellness Exam and shots were too expensive. I love the facility and the staff and the doctors but WOW I have sticker shock!

My Frenchie got a cut near his eye and the staff at the Whitestone Vet Care Group got my dog in very quickly to see Dr. Merker. The staff works as a good team. They took care of my Frenchie right away. I’m happy to recommend them to other pet parents.
Excellent, highly recommend.
My cats always get the best care here.   I usually see Dr Pozo and Joe.  They are both amazing with my babies.
We greatly appreciate your positive feedback. Thank you for choosing Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone for your pet's care.
Best Vet experience we have ever had! The nurses and the doctor were amazing!
Dr. Pozo is a wonderful caring vet. I’m so happy with her level of care for Mia.
Friendly and caring staff

This was my first visit, and everyone working here was incredibly kind. I've been to several other hospitals, but the care here is on a whole different level. I highly recommend it. Thank you so much.
Always happy with my visits at the Whitestone location. They’re so attentive, loving to my snowy.
Amazing care! Friendly staff! Would recommend to everyone
Welcoming and inviting environment. They truly care. Free parking
I take my two Golden Retrievers there. Every vist has been comprehensive and complete, and every single employee gives them loving care. My dogs love to go!
My dog loves going there!  Everyone there is super loving and caring!
Everyone was so nice knowledgeable, they treated Tori an me just like family even though it was my first time there. Such care and love .
We're glad to hear about your positive experience at Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone. Thank you for sharing your feedback!
We're absolutely thrilled to hear about your positive experience at Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.
Wonderful staff and service!
This was the best vet experience! The staff even gave me a toy—it was such a great experience. My pet gets all their checkups here!
We are utterly delighted to hear about your positive experience at Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.
We're ecstatic to hear about your positive experience at Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.
Grate people skills grate team work excellent doctor all so grate can’t complain

Thanks for an informative, helpful and great visit. I had not met the vet before (it was a Saturday in summer and may have been filling in) and he was outstanding. Great guidance about avoiding ticks this summer and Stacy gave me a special clipper in case I find one on Luna. It’s all good!

Once again I am grateful for the care and expertise extended to me and my Luna. I was worried and left a message and was promptly called back after the office opened at 9am. And the care was top flight. Thank you Dr P and the terrific team at VCG. Five stars!

We were absolutely thrilled to receive your feedback and learn about your positive experience at Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone. We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your thoughts with us! Thank you very much.
Amazing caring staff! Best service! Thank you all for your dedication.
Amazing service!!!  Dr and everyone else were super helpful answered all my questions and concerns as a new puppy mom!!!
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for sharing your experience with Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone.

I have only good words for Vet Care Group Whitestone. Both of my cats are currently in their care as well as my two previous cats.  I have been going here for the past 15 years. Dr. Rojas is very knowledgeable and professional. The ENTIRE staff is wonderful.  Whenever I go there or call everyone is so welcoming, polite and eager to help.
Dr Rojas and his staff are very professional and efficient . They are treating our senior dogs with care and knowledge.
They were excellent with my very difficult to handle cat. Very caring and honest about his diagnosis.
All the stuff was so wonderful, I used to be a middle village customer which my dog had an emergency. They were so nice to squeeze him in for a check up, I was so relieved after the exam.

Dr. Pozo and his entire team took excellent care of my dog ​​and treated us very well.
I will definitely continue going to them.
Thank you.
This place is very professional. They show my dogs a lot of love. The staff and Dr. Rojas are great!!!!
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for sharing your experience with Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone.
Thank you for taking the time to share your positive experience with Veterinary Care Group - Whitestone. We sincerely value your feedback.

I had an amazing first experience here! The doctor, DR. Pozo, along with the staff were incredibly professional and sweet with my nervous baby girl. By the end, my baby was wagging her tail with one of the techs and even eating treats him his hand. I am so blessed to have found this location.
Prices are a little high. The stuff is great I think they should give discounts from time to time. They use to cut dog nails if your dog went there for care know it 25 plus taxes A little outrageous.
Very professional and courteous staff

I’ve been coming to Whitestone Veterinary Care Group since my little princess came into my life about 5 years ago and they never seem to disappoint me. They do what is necessary for the animals and always discuss with the pet parents before anything is done. The entire staff from the front desk, to the vet techs to the doctors go above and beyond for not only the pets but the parents as well. It’s such a friendly environment and it puts me at ease when I bring my furbaby there.  You can’t put a price on your furbaby’s health and wellbeing.  Thank you WVCG for taking such good care of Nala and Spark Plug and making them feel comfortable always! The furbabies love you all!  ♥️ 🐾
